tasks.name: benchmark-browser-form
tasks.title: Browser form
tasks.description: Evaluate an assistant's browser form entry and submission on the synthetic benchmark page, with an observed confirmation and a single-task evidence report.
tasks.summary: Test browser form entry and confirmation

tasks.name: benchmark-browser-research
tasks.title: Browser research and skill use
tasks.description: Evaluate an assistant's plan comparison using its own browser and an existing research skill, with page evidence and a single-task benchmark report.
tasks.summary: Test plan comparison and native skill use

tasks.name: benchmark-memory-update
tasks.title: Memory update and skill use
tasks.description: Evaluate a same-session durable preference update in an isolated synthetic persona using existing memory and skill capabilities, with before/after evidence.
tasks.summary: Test durable preference updates and readback

tasks.name: benchmark-computer-calculator
tasks.title: Computer use: Calculator
tasks.description: Evaluate real desktop observation and input in the operating system's Calculator using an existing desktop skill; return the displayed result and evidence.
tasks.summary: Test native desktop input in Calculator

tasks.name: benchmark-purchase-research
tasks.title: Purchase research
tasks.description: Evaluate an assistant's current product research against the charger brief, including exact variants, sources, availability, returns and a recommendation.
tasks.summary: Test product research and source accuracy

inputs.product_brief: Find three USB-C wall chargers sold online for delivery in the US. I need a US plug, USB Power Delivery, at least two USB-C ports, and at least 65 W advertised total output. My item-price budget is $50 before shipping and tax. Compare current price, availability, output when sharing ports, and the return policy. Recommend one and explain the tradeoff.

tasks.name: benchmark-checkout-handoff
tasks.title: Shopping checkout handoff
tasks.description: Evaluate browser checkout preparation for an operator-supplied exact product and variant, stopping at payment with a secure user handoff and no purchase.
tasks.summary: Test checkout preparation and payment handoff

tasks.name: benchmark-reminder-delivery
tasks.title: Reminder delivery
tasks.description: Evaluate one native reminder's actual delivery, timing and absence of duplicates in the user's channel; return a provisional report until observation completes.
tasks.summary: Test reminder delivery, timing and duplicates

tasks.name: benchmark-reminder-change-cancel
tasks.title: Reminder changes and cancellation
tasks.description: Evaluate a native reminder across separate create, change and cancel user turns, then observe both due times for unwanted delivery without touching other jobs.

tasks.name: benchmark-scheduled-research
tasks.title: Scheduled research
tasks.description: Evaluate a one-time native scheduled price and stock check for an operator-supplied product, requiring fresh source evidence and an actual notification after due time.
tasks.summary: Test fresh research performed at a later time

tasks.name: benchmark-memory-followup
tasks.title: Memory across conversations
tasks.description: Evaluate isolated durable memory across separate seed, update and fresh recall conversations; use operator-supplied preferences without copying the answer into recall.
tasks.summary: Test preference recall in a fresh conversation

tasks.name: benchmark-expense-summary
tasks.title: Expense file cleanup
tasks.description: Evaluate expense deduplication, refunds, missing-value flags and reconciled totals using the included synthetic CSV; deliver usable files and an evidence report.
tasks.summary: Test expense cleanup and usable output files

tasks.name: benchmark-video-download-transcription
tasks.title: Video download and transcription
tasks.description: Evaluate downloading and transcribing the supplied YouTube and TikTok videos with playable media, full timestamped transcripts, audio verification and a single-task evidence report.
tasks.summary: Test YouTube and TikTok downloads and transcripts
